scope_groups.header: Site Concrete - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and place concrete flatwork, curbs, take-off boards, athletic equipment pads, and turndown edges as indicated, including all layout.
Supply and install concrete curbs at the Synthetic Turf Sports Field and Running Track, and concrete equipment pads including the transformer pad.

Supply and install the slot drain / trench drain and concrete curb system along the track perimeter per detail D/L1.03, including excavation, trenching, bedding, backfill, piping, collector pipe, cleanouts, and drainage structures for a complete system. Connection to the site storm drainage system by others.

Provide cast-in-place footings for the Scoreboard, Press Box, Prefabricated Ticket Booth (slab-on-grade and footings), Bleacher footings/grade beams, and Track & Field Athletic Equipment (goal posts, high jump posts, etc.) as indicated, including excavation, backfill and overexcavation per the Geotechnical Report. Coordinate requirements with each respective equipment Subcontractor.
Bleacher footings are based on the manufacturer's foundation design, in lieu of the foundation shown on the structural drawings.

Excavate drilled piers and place concrete backfill around the Musco-furnished precast bases at sports field light poles, per E0-05. Coordinate pole locations and conduit interface with Electrical Subcontractor.
Install steel embeds, base plates and anchor bolts supplied by others; provide dry pack and non-shrink grout at base plates as indicated.
Install bollards supplied by others; provide concrete footings, infill, and domed tops.
Supply and place Type II aggregate base beneath this Scope of Work's flatwork, curbs and pads, on subgrade prepared and compacted by others.
Includes footing and installation for one flagpole, flagpole supplied by others.

scope_groups.header: Cast-in-Place Structural Concrete - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install continuous footings, slab-on-grade, and turned-down edges at the Concessions Building, including all layout.
Provide concrete housekeeping and equipment pads, including curbs, at the Concessions Building as indicated on the MEP drawings.
Provide concrete pour backs at floor sinks and restroom slope-to-drain locations.
Provide stepped footings at utility entrances; assume a 3-foot step.
Excavate, backfill and compact building wall and isolated footings with approved fill material.
Furnish and install Type II and vapor/moisture barrier at slabs-on-grade per the Geotechnical Report, installed after other trades complete underground rough-in.
Supply and install damproofing / waterproofing at footings and foundations.
Demonstrate joint and finish conditions on a 15'x15' mockup slab on-site; coordinate location and requirements with the onsite Superintendent.
Provide layout from Contractor-furnished hubs, including gridline back-checking and batter boards for use by other trades.
Coordinate with Wet Utilities, Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical & Low Voltage Subcontractors for fixtures, conduits, and sleeves in slab-on-grade.
Coordinate masonry rebar laps with Masonry Subcontractor; rebar lap to start at Finish Floor unless directed otherwise.
Supply, install and maintain rebar safety caps until Masonry Subcontractor assumes responsibility.
Supply and place all formwork, blocking and shoring for this Scope of Work.
Supply and install all reinforcing steel, including rebar, welded wire fabric, dowels and accessories, for this Scope of Work's footings and slabs.
Haul off dirt spoils and clean and remove debris generated by this Scope of Work; provide containment for concrete truck washout.
Provide dust control, street cleaning, barricades and flagging per Nye County Air Quality and Contractor requirements.

exclusions: Concrete pad under existing visitors bleachers
Fence, gate and site sign post footings
Cost of independent testing and special inspection services

_amount_note: The four lines above sum to Sahara's submitted base proposal, $1,518,456.00 -- NOT the carried Subcontract Amount, $1,278,459.84 (delta $239,996.16, about 15.8%). The gap is not reconciled in any document read. Sahara's own undated Homework Response R2 prices a series of post-bid adds and deducts against this same base -- the largest a ($303,159.00) deduct for 'Breakout Drain Straights' -- that could account for most of it, but the negotiated Basis of Proposal (07.01.26), which is the governing document, does not mention any reduction to the ACO/slot-drain scope under its '030 CONCRETE' heading. See _open_pm_items.

_open_pm_items.title: Subcontract Amount is $239,996.16 below Sahara's submitted base proposal, and the reduction is not documented
_open_pm_items.detail: Sahara's 05.11.26 base proposal is $1,518,456; the GMP BackSheet / Procore budget carries $1,278,459.84. Sahara's own undated Homework Response R2 prices a long list of post-bid adds and deducts against the same base -- most significantly a ($303,159.00) deduct for 'Breakout Drain Straights' -- that could explain most of the gap, but the negotiated Basis of Proposal (07.01.26), which governs, does not mention any reduction to the ACO/slot-drain system under its own '030 CONCRETE' heading. The exhibit carries the full slot-drain system (straights and radius) per the Scope of Work narrative, consistent with the governing document. Confirm which R2 items were actually accepted into the GMP before issuing the subcontract, and if the 'straights' portion of the drain system was in fact removed, confirm which package now carries it -- RFP-008's own leveling tab separately prices 'Perforated SD along turf straight sides' as an add.

_open_pm_items.title: NDOT headwall priced by Sahara but superseded by an Owner Accepted Alternate
_open_pm_items.detail: Sahara's base backup carries a $5,500 line for a cast-in-place 'NDOT Headwall,' consistent with the base-bid civil drawings (G1/G2). The negotiated Basis of Proposal, under its '008' heading, states the field storm drain discharge is now an RCP flared end in lieu of the cast-in-place concrete headwall detail (Owner Accepted Alternate) -- precast pipe hardware, not concrete. The exhibit excludes the headwall. Confirm the $5,500 is credited back as buyout savings and confirm which package (if any) now carries the RCP flared end.

_open_pm_items.title: Flagpole count and trade boundary with ITB-078 unresolved
_open_pm_items.detail: Sahara's base backup separately lists 'Flag Pole Bases 3 ea' inside its $1,186,334 site concrete total, and separately priced Alternate 030.01 (Flagpole Footing and Installation) at $16,500. The negotiated Basis of Proposal, under its '078 FLAGPOLES' heading, states the base scope is 'Furnish and Install (1) Flagpole (Owner Accepted Alternate, delete two of three flagpoles shown)' -- assigned to the Flagpoles package (ITB-078), not Concrete. It is unclear whether ITB-078 now furnishes and installs the pole complete, including its footing, or whether this Scope of Work still sets the footing for one pole per its own Alternate 030.01 language ('provide flagpole foundation, install flagpole [provided by others]'). The exhibit carries one flagpole footing and installation, consistent with the reduced count; confirm the trade boundary with ITB-078 and correct Sahara's base price for the reduced count before issuing.

_open_pm_items.title: Mow curb status is contradictory across the documents on hand
_open_pm_items.detail: Addendum #1's revision of A1-20 prints 'MOW CURB REMOVED FROM PROJECT' directly on the site details sheet. The civil grading plans (G1/G2, dated 04.14.26 and not reissued with the addendum) still carry 'Mow Curb 12x12' in their legend; the pre-award leveling tab (BP030) lists mow curbs as an included base-bid item for all four bidders; Cheek's scope-review agenda assumed 'handset for mow curb'; and Sahara's own Homework Response R2 separately prices 'Add Mow Curb in lieu of trench drain +$36,850' as a post-bid option. The exhibit does not name mow curb separately -- any remaining requirement is carried inside the general site-curb item. Confirm whether mow curb is in or out of the base scope and whether Sahara's price needs adjustment either way.

_open_pm_items.title: Visitors bleachers concrete pad -- confirm Sahara's price reflects the exclusion
_open_pm_items.detail: Sahara's 05.15.26 Scope Review Meeting Agenda (its current document) states 'Assume concrete at the visitors' bleachers.' The negotiated Basis of Proposal (07.01.26), under its own '030 CONCRETE' heading, excludes the concrete pad under the existing visitors bleachers by name. The exhibit follows the later, governing document and excludes it. Sahara's Homework Response R2 separately prices 'Deduct Slab at Visitors Bleachers (concrete existing) ($20,510.00),' consistent with the exclusion, but it is not confirmed as accepted into the carried price. Confirm before issue.

_open_pm_items.title: Awarded price is not the low bid
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package record. Of four bidders (Cheek $1,294,656, The Monument Company $1,113,208, Sahara $1,518,456, XL Concrete Masonry $1,605,417), Sahara's proposal was not the lowest; the pre-award leveling workbook (BP030, 05.13.26) names The Monument Company the front-runner on base price. The GMP BackSheet nonetheless carries Sahara at (a reduced) $1,278,459.84. Confirm the basis of award.

_open_pm_items.title: Sahara's proposal excludes items the Scope of Work narrative requires -- not adopted
_open_pm_items.detail: Three conflicts between Sahara's own exclusion list and the contract documents, none silently adopted: (1) Sahara excludes 'Multiple mobilizations,' while the narrative requires multiple mobilizations per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan (carried in the exhibit's mobilization field). (2) Sahara excludes 'Water proofing,' while the narrative requires damproofing/waterproofing at the Concessions Building footings and foundations (kept in the exhibit). (3) Sahara excludes 'Over excavation,' while the narrative requires footing excavation including overexcavation per the Geotechnical Report (kept in the exhibit). Reconcile Sahara's price against all three before issuing.

_open_pm_items.title: Caliche / hard rock removal at footing excavations is unresolved
_open_pm_items.detail: Sahara's proposal excludes 'Caliche or hard rock removal.' Cheek's (non-awarded) scope-review agenda assumed 'Includes hard dig.' Neither the Scope of Work narrative nor the Geotechnical Report excerpt read resolves which package absorbs a hard-dig condition specifically at footing excavations, distinct from RFP-008's mass-grading hard dig (separately flagged on that package, see TAB's +$70,000 D-10 dozer add). Left unresolved -- not written into the exhibit either way.

_open_pm_items.title: XL Concrete Masonry bid RFP-030 and RFP-031 as one bundled scope -- moot
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package record. XL's proposal bundles pricing and scope language across both packages. Moot: RFP-030 is carried with Sahara Concrete and RFP-031 with Henderson Masonry, so nothing needs splitting.

review_appendix._purpose: PM request 08.11.26. Rule 14 strips every obligation the specs and drawings already carry. This lists what was stripped so the PM can put any of it back. Draft only -- build with --final to suppress it.
intro: Rule 14 keeps out of this exhibit anything the Contract Documents already state, so the Subcontract carries one copy of each obligation rather than two that can drift.

Every line below was drafted, verified and then removed on that basis. All of them still bind the Subcontractor through the document named beneath them. Tick any that should be restated in the Scope of Work above.
